steps.label: Dedicated account
steps.sub: when a Pod genuinely calls the API

eyebrow: A ServiceAccount, bound like a user
code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: catalog-sync
  namespace: catalog
---
# RoleBinding subjects use kind: ServiceAccount
subjects:
  - kind: ServiceAccount
    name: catalog-sync
    namespace: catalog
caption: Binding a Role to a ServiceAccount works exactly like binding one to a User.

eyebrow: The Pod opts in by name
code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
spec:
  serviceAccountName: catalog-sync
  containers:
    - name: catalog-sync
      image: northbridge/catalog-sync:1.3
caption: Kubernetes mounts catalog-sync's token into the container, scoped to exactly its bound RBAC rules.

eyebrow: Most Pods never call the API at all

steps.label: automountServiceAccountToken: false
steps.sub: no token mounted into checkout's Pods
